scope: Define structural_top3_surprisal semantics for races with exactly 3 actual starters.

n_eq_3.reason: C(3,3)=1 and the only unordered Top3 set is the full starter set, so P0(A_r)=1 and the normalized surprisal is 0/0.

race_head.training_rows: Only races with n_r >= 4 and otherwise-valid structural labels.
race_head.crossfit_prediction_rows: Only races with n_r >= 4 are required to receive upset_score.
race_head.n_eq_3_temperature_rule: Use M0 temperature T0 exactly; do not apply gamma modulation.

m1_temperature_fit.standardization_rows: Only race-head crossfit rows with n_r >= 4.
m1_temperature_fit.mu_sigma: Compute mean and population std ddof=0 from raw upset_score on n_r >= 4 M1-fit rows only.
m1_temperature_fit.objective_rows: Use only n_r >= 4 races for M1 T0/gamma fitting because the temperature head is structurally undefined at n_r=3.

r1.evaluation_rows: Outer-VALID races with n_r >= 4 and defined U_r only.
r1.fold_rho: Compute per-fold Spearman only on defined structural rows.
r1.pooled_rho: Compute pooled Spearman only on defined structural rows.
r1.mae: Compute head MAE and constant-baseline MAE only on defined structural rows.
r1.constant_baseline_mean: Fold-specific mean U over available outer-TRAIN crossfitted structural-label races with n_r >= 4.

r2.delta: NLL_M1 - NLL_M0 on structural-eligible races only.
r2.bootstrap: Date-block bootstrap uses the dates/races contributing to the n_r>=4 R2 evaluation; n_r=3 races contribute no R2 statistic.

probability_model_and_s2.outer_valid_joint_nll: Keep n_r=3 races in ordinary B0/Primary probability evaluation; their unordered Top3 NLL is exactly 0 when integrity holds.
probability_model_and_s2.wide: Keep n_r=3 races in WIDE probability outputs/metrics/floor support. Exact WIDE probability is 1 for each of the three pairs and sum pair probability is 3.
probability_model_and_s2.s2: Evaluate S2 on the full accepted probability universe, including n_r=3 races. For n_r=3, selected Primary M1 equals M0 by construction because z_upset=0.
probability_model_and_s2.pl_integrity: All existing PL integrity checks remain required.

hard_checks: all n_r=3 races are labeled STRUCTURAL_TARGET_UNDEFINED_TRIVIAL_FIELD
U_r is null/NaN for n_r=3; never 0 or fabricated
n_r=3 races remain present in ordinary probability and WIDE outputs

unchanged: PL formulas and optimization for n_r>=4
